operations.description: List the calendars on the signed-in user's calendar list, one page per call; the walk follows nextPageToken as pageToken and ends on the page carrying nextSyncToken, which a later call sends as syncToken, with the same other parameters, without minAccessRole or showOwnOrganizationOnly and with neither showDeleted nor showHidden set to false, to read only the entries changed since; that end condition holds only if fields, when given, includes nextPageToken and nextSyncToken, so include both, and keep deleted and hidden, which mark a removed entry in a delta (for example nextPageToken,nextSyncToken,items(id,summary,deleted,hidden)); a 410 (not_found) means the sync token expired: drop it and walk again without it

List the events of calendarId (primary for the signed-in user's own), one page per call, optionally within timeMin..timeMax or changed after updatedMin, with singleEvents to expand recurring events and eventTypes (an array) to select types; the walk follows nextPageToken as pageToken and ends on the page carrying nextSyncToken; that end condition holds only if fields, when given, includes nextPageToken and nextSyncToken, so include both, and keep status, which marks a deleted event as cancelled in a delta (for example nextPageToken,nextSyncToken,items(id,status,summary,start,end)). A later call sends nextSyncToken as syncToken to read only the events changed since; that delta repeats every other parameter of the full walk, and syncToken cannot be sent with timeMin, timeMax, updatedMin, q, orderBy, iCalUID or the extended-property filters, nor with showDeleted set to false, so a walk meant for sync tokens sends none of them (a windowed walk cannot be continued by a delta). A not_found on a sync-token request means either the sync token expired or the calendar is gone: walk again from the first page without syncToken; if that walk also answers not_found the calendar is gone, otherwise replace the mirror with it and keep its nextSyncToken (calendarList.list is no test of a gone calendar: it never lists primary by that id and leaves hidden calendars out unless showHidden is true)
Read one event by calendarId and eventId
